rules.headRegistration: All painted masters intentionally share the approved head/neck origin; no moving faces.
rules.poseFallback: Same garment/shoe ordinary painting; never delete options.
rules.ownership: Each body region has exactly one painted owner; full suit replaces all body regions.
rules.sourceMasks: Anatomical contour selections only, no silhouette-scaled garments or global body row truncation.

wearRules.explanation: Pants own covered legs; barefoot lower sprites are not drawn under long trousers. Shoe shaft position is resolved per garment, never a universal z-index.
